description: This source file defines the ReportGeneratorService class, which provides various functionalities related to report generation, including fetching report headers, normalizing data, saving reports, and constructing query builders with filters and sorting in a HR management system.

classes.name: ReportGeneratorService
classes.description: Service class responsible for generating reports, managing report metadata, query building, data normalization, and report saving functionalities within a HR management system.

methods.name: getReportGeneratorDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the ReportGeneratorDao instance used for database interactions.

methods.name: isPimReport
methods.description: Checks whether a specific report identified by reportId is of type 'PIM_DEFINED'.

methods.name: getHeaderData
methods.description: Retrieves header data for a given report, including display fields and grouping information.

methods.name: getHeaderGroupsForDisplayFields
methods.description: Constructs header groups for display fields, organizing them into default and grouped columns.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinitionByReportId
methods.description: Creates a Header object with metadata for a report identified by reportId.

methods.name: getNormalizedReportData
methods.description: Fetches and normalizes report data, converting DTO objects to strings and arrays for output.

methods.name: getReportDataCount
methods.description: Counts total number of report data entries matching specific filter parameters.

methods.name: getReportDataQueryBuilder
methods.description: Builds a Doctrine QueryBuilder with filters, sorting, and pagination based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getHashKeyForFilterParamObject
methods.description: Generates a hash key for caching query results based on filter parameters.

methods.name: setSortingAndPaginationParams
methods.description: Applies sorting and pagination to the query builder based on filter parameters.

methods.name: setJoinsToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds necessary join clauses to the query builder for entity relationships.

methods.name: setJoinToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a specific join to the query builder if dependencies exist.

methods.name: savePimDefinedReport
methods.description: Saves a report of type 'PIM_DEFINED' with selected fields, filters, and header groups.

methods.name: getInitializedFilterFieldInstance
methods.description: Creates and initializes a filter field instance based on class name and selected filter data.

methods.name: generateSelectedFilterFieldsByCriteria
methods.description: Generates filter fields for a report based on predefined criteria array.

methods.name: generateSelectedFilterFieldForIncludeEmployee
methods.description: Creates a special filter field for employee inclusion based on includeType parameter.

methods.name: modifySelectedFilterFieldValues
methods.description: Modifies filter field values (X and Y) based on functional modifiers.

methods.name: getDisplayFields
methods.description: Retrieves all display fields grouped by their groups, including labels and IDs.
